text: The company that powers most of today's AI was dreamed up in a Denny's diner!
Why should we care how Nvidia started?
Because its chips now run most of the world's AI... and it began by making video-game graphics.
In nineteen ninety-three, three engineers met in a Denny's in San Jose, to plan a 3D graphics chip.
In two thousand six, Nvidia unveiled CUDA, so its chips could do almost any kind of maths.
So how did games turn into AI?
In twenty twelve, a Toronto team trained an AI called AlexNet on two gaming cards, and crushed the competition.
AI researchers rushed to Nvidia's chips.
It touched one trillion dollars in twenty twenty-three, and in October twenty twenty-five became the first company ever worth five trillion.
Like, follow History Sketches, and tell us what we should map next!
And in twenty twenty-three, Denny's hung a plaque above the booth where it was dreamed up.
